SELECT VBB.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, VBT.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, VBB.BALANCE_DATE as bookDate, VBB.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, VBS.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, VBB.O_CCY as oCcy, VBB.NUM_AMT as numAmt,
if(VBB.BAL_FLAG= 'C', VBB.O_AMT, -VBB.O_AMT) oAmt, if(VBB.BAL_FLAG= 'C', VBB.B_AMT, -VBB.B_AMT) bAmt, VBS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE FROM BOK_BALANCE VBB
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET VBT ON VBB.BOOKSET_ID = VBT.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT VBS ON VBT.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL = VBS.BOOKSET_ID AND VBB.SUBJECT_NO = VBS.SUBJECT_NO
WHERE VBB.BALANCE_DATE = #{bookDate} AND VBB.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND VBS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN (#{baseSubjectNature01},#{baseSubjectNature02}) AND VBB.SUBJECT_LEVEL = '3' ORDER BY VBB.BOOKSET_ID,VBB.SUBJECT_NO,VBB.O_CCY

SELECT SUM(A.B_HAPPEN_AMT * if(A.CD_FLAG='C',1,-1)) FROM BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT A, BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO B, BOK_BOOKSET C WHERE A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = B.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND A.SUBJECT_NO = '22060201' AND A.TABLE_ID = '8105' AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{bookDate} AND C.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{acctSubjectId}
